issues.description: Class name mismatch: the problem statement (UML) and the solution refer to a class named Meal with constructor Meal(String, String[]) and getters, but the template repository does not provide Meal (Meal.java is empty) and instead provides an Order class (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Order.java) that models the same concept (name + ingredients). This inconsistent identifier (Meal vs Order) across the problem statement, template, and solution will confuse students which class to implement and may cause compilation or test failures if exercises/tests expect Meal.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the identifier consistent across all artifacts. Prefer one of two options: (A) Replace the template's Order class with a Meal class: rename Order.java to Meal.java (or add a Meal.java stub) implementing the constructor Meal(String, String[]) and the corresponding getters, and update any template references/comments; or (B) Update the problem statement and solution to use Order instead of Meal. Option (A) is recommended: add a Meal.java in the template matching the UML/signature and either remove Order.java or keep it only if renamed/aliased, ensuring tests and Main reference Meal. Document the change in README to avoid further confusion.
